original_title: Echocardiography Insourcing
english_summary: This tender is for the provision of BSE accredited echocardiographers to perform adult cardiac transthoracic echocardiogram studies at NHS Royal Cornwall Hospitals Trust sites. The service includes both outpatient and inpatient echocardiography using the Trust's GE echo machines, with reporting uploaded to the Maxims EPR system.
what_they_want: BSE accredited echocardiographers to deliver adult cardiac transthoracic echocardiograms (TTE) using GE Echo machines at multiple sites including Bodmin, WCH Community Diagnostic Centres, and RCHT Truro. eligibility_requirements: Echocardiographers must be BSE (British Society of Echocardiography) accredited.
